scope: Edit evaluator Code judge only; no Builder or Candidate runtime changes
dependency_reason: Base Builder image lacks requests; original Code judge failed before a provider request. Add only hash-inventoried, already installed Harbor HTTP dependencies, no network downloads.
transport: V28 forwards Create's existing stream/nonstream selection; default stream, same provider endpoint order. V29 fixes Python 3.12 HTTPS handler compatibility using default SSLContext certificate/hostname verification, with no verification bypass. Complete SSE response objects are extracted without resampling; exact redacted raw stream retained separately.
stream_module: responses_stream.py, read-only evaluator mount included in source bindings and preflight
per_attempt_evidence: durable intent, received HTTP status, completed/unknown usage and redacted full/partial response; no unknown response is silently repeated
transport_policy_reason: User's Edit protocol explicitly permits only one completed logical score. Current Create runner otherwise retries completed invalid score JSON. Edit entry blocks this second request; it also does not retry uncertain delivery, malformed completed envelopes or nonretryable HTTP responses.
code_policy: current Create raw_score_final; caps are diagnostics only
preflight: same container image and read-only inputs; network none; no credential mount; complete source pack and expected frozen digest validated before any paid request
container_lifecycle: Each preflight/judge Docker invocation has a random ownership label and unique name. On exit, timeout or SIGINT/SIGTERM, inspect exact ownership, remove only the matched container, and independently verify its absence. Unknown Docker state is not cleanup success.
outer_timeout_reason: Host-side orphan protection: all transient provider attempts share the existing 900-second deadline, plus 180 seconds for source packing/container teardown only; no model or lower-agent budget extension.
source_scope_policy: Default full Create source pack. A task-owned baseline-locked scope may use Create's native evidence-path support only with explicit complete change coverage, required context and no planner errors. Entire frozen tree identity remains validated.
